conceptZh: 兔子魔術師用力一揮魔杖，變出的燕子衝過頭飛出畫面又折回來，第二次輕輕一揮，燕子停在「燕」字上。
object: a cartoon magician rabbit in a purple top hat with a star-tipped wand, and a small glossy-feathered paper-craft swallow with a forked tail
morph: a swallow overshoots the stage, comes back, and settles as the strokes of 燕 with its four dots as tail feathers
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：兔子魔術師用力過猛，燕子飛過頭撞到舞台邊又彈回，第二次輕輕一揮才把筆畫排好，尾巴剛好是下面四點。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and cheerful, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-peach stage backdrop with a small striped curtain edge at the far left and right. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated deep-teal Traditional Chinese glyph 燕, with its top 廿 part, the 北 in the middle, the small 口 in the heart and the four dots along the bottom, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original cartoon magician rabbit in a purple top hat with a star-tipped wand and long floppy ears; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the rabbit hops to center, winds up like a baseball pitcher and swings his wand with way too much power; a tiny forked-tail swallow whooshes out of the hat, shoots straight across the stage and vanishes off the right edge, the first spoken 燕 landing with the whoosh, while the rabbit spins on one foot and his ears wrap around his face. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the swallow boomerangs back from the left, zips past again, bonks the curtain and drops a few feathers; the rabbit slaps his own forehead, then peeks out from between his ears. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): he takes a deep breath and gives a tiny, gentle flick; the second 燕 is spoken as the swallow floats in softly and settles, its body unfolding into the strokes of 燕 while the four tail feathers drop neatly into the four dots at the bottom, and the word 燕子 is spoken just as a little feather-flap puff of sparkles pops and the rabbit takes a bow. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 燕 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp; the rabbit stands to the side, tipping his top hat and doing a tiny happy hop, ears bouncing, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「燕、燕、燕子」, read as ㄧㄢˋ、ㄧㄢˋ、ㄧㄢˋ ㄗ˙, first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 3.0s, the word at about 4.5s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft whoosh and a gentle chime under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
